**Checkpoint C** closes the randomness block (Weeks 8–10): establishment → **evolutionary rescue**.

## Submit (practical)

1. Brief model in words (decline + rare adapted types + establishment).
2. Simulator + one key figure (e.g. rescue probability vs stress or \(s\)).
3. Short note linking to **lab** evolutionary-rescue experiments (what a replicate culture measures).
4. Strongest assumption / what would falsify the model.

## Presentation (~3–5 min)

Question → computation → one figure → lab link / limitation.

## AI disclosure (required)

See [AI policy](../../docs/ai-policy.qmd). Disclose tool + use, or `AI disclosure: none`.
